caption:
Mortgage rates dipped again. 🏠

Freddie Mac says the average 30-year fixed rate was 7.18% last week, down from 7.24%. That's the third weekly dip in a row.

But a year ago it was 6.22%. So "better" is still a lot higher than before.

If you're house hunting, does 7% feel doable or not even close?
first_comment: Renters and buyers: what monthly payment would actually feel comfortable to you? 👇
